quest_name: Innocence Lost (lured Grelod to the docks)
outcome: Tricked Grelod the Kind into following him to the Riften docks to kill her out of sight
citation: B04 tier A, a stage this QE ADDS to vanilla DB01 (vanilla has 0/5/20/30/200/255; the mod adds 21/22/198/199/201). s21 'I've convinced Grelod the Kind that Aventus Aretino is just outside Riften. She's agreed to follow me to the docks, where I can then get rid of her discreetly.' s22 'Grelod is at the docks, where no one can see her. Time to get rid of her.' RUNTIME-VERIFY: non-terminal, so reachability down this path is not proven by the record alone.
branch_note: Branch 1 of 2 that this expansion adds. Still a killing, but by lure and ambush rather than the vanilla confrontation - hence deceit alongside the murder.

outcome: Had Grelod the Kind imprisoned in Riften jail rather than killing her and went to check on the orphans
citation: B04 tier A, a stage this QE ADDS: s198 'I should check on the children at the Honorhall Orphanage now that Grelod is spending the rest of her days at Riften's jail.' This is the expansion's whole point - a lawful resolution to a vanilla quest that otherwise only offers murder. RUNTIME-VERIFY: non-terminal.

quest_name: Innocence Lost (jailed; she died in custody)
outcome: Left Grelod to the law and learned she was later killed in prison by another hand
citation: B04 tier A and CompleteQuest-flagged, a stage this QE ADDS: s199 'It turns out Grelod was killed while imprisoned. Perhaps Aventus Aretino actually managed to summon the Dark Brotherhood after all.' Tagged for the player's OWN act - the imprisonment at s198 - and deliberately NOT murder_treacherous: the record says she was killed by someone else while in custody.
branch_note: Terminal of branch 2. Stage 201 carries identical text and is rowed too, since the quest can land on either.
